first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both currently declining, and prior evidence indicates that simplifying onboarding durably improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This directly addresses the most controllable leading indicators of sustainable qualified revenue; pricing remains a strong alternative for the competitor-driven SMB threat and should be verified before final commitment.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding for self-serve/SMB accounts. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting durable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is not selected because its verified qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to sustain through renewal.
